customer_acme_inc: Hey team — since the quantize swap last night our downstream ETL started failing on structured outputs. Previously we got a flat JSON object; now responses are sometimes wrapped, sometimes have trailing commas, or get truncated. Blocking batch jobs. Sample request/response below.

customer_acme_inc: curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-3-2.2-quant","prompt":"generate schema for order","output_format":"json"}'

customer_acme_inc: Response we see (note it's the "text" field from the choices):

customer_acme_inc: ```
{
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "{ \"order_id\": 987, \"status\": \"created\", \"items\": [ { \"sku\": \"X1\", \"qty\": 2 } ], }"
    }
  ]
}
```

customer_acme_inc: That inner JSON has a trailing comma after the array, which causes our parser to crash. Other examples: sometimes the model returns a top-level array instead of object, or wraps the payload under "result": {...}. We did not change our client.

maria: Thanks for flagging — sorry for the disruption. Can you paste a request_id or a few full responses (raw) and the timeframe? We'll escalate immediately.

customer_acme_inc: Request IDs: req_208f3a, req_208f3b, req_208f3c. All between 22:10-22:18 UTC last night. ETA: this broke our scheduled ETL at 22:30 so high priority.

support-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4532. Assigned to eng-ml and eng-runtime. Notifying oncall.

ajay: Looking. Are you using the "output_format":"json" param or post-processing the freeform text? Any autop-formatting plugin on your side?

customer_acme_inc: We set output_format=json explicitly. No post-processing besides a strict JSON.parse in our ETL. This didn't happen before the quantize push.

leo_eng: I can reproduce locally with redwood/llama-3-2.2-quant on a short prompt. Seeing occasional trailing commas emitted by the jsonifier when using the quantized beam path. Suspect a tokenization boundary bug introduced in the quant kernel that appends a stray comma token at end-of-object.

leo_eng: Quick workaround: pin model to redwood/llama-3-2.1-quant (previous revision) or use the raw text path and run a sanitizer that strips trailing commas. We'll prioritize a rollback/fix.

maria: For customers: set model parameter to "redwood/llama-3-2.1-quant" to restore stable outputs. We'll push an advisory doc in the next hour.

customer_acme_inc: Pinning to 2.1 fixed the ETL on first run. Appreciate quick action — keep me posted on permanent fix.

ajay: Noted. We're adding a regression test to the quantized inference CI that validates structured outputs for common prompt templates. We'll also add a small post-generation sanitizer as belt-and-suspenders until kernel is patched.

support-bot: Update INC-4532: triage complete, workaround applied for affected customers, priority: P1.

leo_eng: Follow-up: we've identified the offending token emission in the dequant path; patching now. Will schedule a controlled redeploy and run canary on a small % of traffic.

customer_acme_inc: Thanks — ping me before you roll so we can avoid the 22:30 ETL window.

maria: Copy that. We'll coordinate maintenance window.

customer_acme_inc: Confirmed everything green on our side after pin. We'll hold on the next run until you confirm the fixed build.
